title: Zoo Code — .roo/codebase-index.json
description: Per-project configuration for Zoo Code's codebase-index feature. Safe to commit; must not contain credentials. Place this file at {workspace}/.roo/codebase-index.json (project-local) or ~/.roo/codebase-index.json (user-global).

$schema.description: Points at this schema so editors can offer autocomplete.

codebaseIndexEnabled.description: Whether codebase indexing is active for this workspace. Setting this to false here force-disables it team-wide regardless of global settings.

codebaseIndexQdrantUrl.description: Qdrant server URL, including scheme and port. Example: http://team-qdrant.internal:6333

codebaseIndexEmbedderProvider.description: Which embedding provider to use for this workspace.

codebaseIndexEmbedderBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the embedder — used by Ollama (e.g. http://ollama:11434).

codebaseIndexEmbedderModelId.description: Embedder model ID. Example: text-embedding-3-small (openai), nomic-embed-text (ollama).

codebaseIndexEmbedderModelDimension.description: Override embedding vector dimension. Normally inferred from the model.

codebaseIndexSearchMinScore.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0–1) for a result to be returned.

codebaseIndexSearchMaxResults.description: Maximum number of results returned per search (10–200).

codebaseIndexOpenAiCompatibleBaseUrl.description: Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint.

codebaseIndexOpenAiCompatibleModelDimens.description: Vector dimension when using openai-compatible provider.

codebaseIndexBedrockRegion.description: AWS region for Bedrock embeddings. Example: us-east-1.

codebaseIndexOpenRouterSpecificProvider.description: Constrain OpenRouter to a specific downstream provider.

^code(base)?IndexOpen(Ai|Router)|^code(b.description: API keys are never accepted here. Store them in VS Code settings (global or workspace) — not in a committable file.
